$comment: Intake question 3 (app type) picks one entry. 'core' is built by every system in wave 1 (it holds the docs book's own controls). An app type adds its own components to wave 1, then lists what waves 2 and 3 take on and which working scenarios open the book. milestone.mjs reads intake.appType from kiln.config.json and requires core + the type's wave1. Names follow Pane's catalog, so a component's derivation in Pane can be read as a worked example.

dashboard.label: Dashboard or admin tool
scenarios: a metrics overview with a date range
a table of records with filters, bulk actions and an empty state
a settings page that saves and fails

commerce.label: Shop or marketplace
scenarios: a product page with size, quantity and a cart total
checkout in steps with a refused payment
search results with filters and nothing found

media.label: Media, music or video
scenarios: a player that really plays, with a queue
a library grid that loads and is empty
offline mode said in words

booking.label: Booking or scheduling
scenarios: pick a date and a slot, closed days greyed
confirm with a code that can be wrong
a booking that is full

chat.label: Chat, social or messaging
scenarios: a conversation that sends, fails and resends
a feed that loads more and runs out
a profile with an empty state

ai-assistant.label: AI assistant or agent tool
scenarios: an answer that streams with sources
a step the agent cannot do and hands to a person
a long task with progress and a stop

finance.label: Banking or finance
scenarios: a transfer with a limit and a code
a statement table filtered by month
a balance that cannot load

productivity.label: Productivity, notes or project tool
scenarios: a board where cards move between columns
a note that saves as you type and fails
a command palette that finds anything

learning.label: Learning or education
scenarios: a lesson with a quiz that marks answers
a course path with progress
a streak that breaks

home-iot.label: Smart home or device control
scenarios: a room whose lights follow the sliders
a device that stops answering
a schedule for night

content.label: Content site, blog or documentation
scenarios: an article with a table of contents that follows
search with nothing found
a docs page with code to copy
